merged_issues.title: Missing or empty document title
merged_issues.description: The page does not include a non-empty <title> element. A descriptive title helps screen reader users understand the page context and improves navigation and discoverability.
merged_issues.recommended_fix: Add a meaningful, non-empty <title> in the document <head>, e.g. <title>Page name – Site name</title>, and ensure it updates appropriately for each page/view.

merged_issues.title: Missing main landmark
merged_issues.description: The document does not have a main landmark (<main> or role="main"). A single main landmark helps assistive technology users quickly jump to the primary content.
merged_issues.recommended_fix: Wrap the primary page content in a single <main> element (or add role="main" to the main content container) and ensure there is only one main landmark per page.

merged_issues.title: No clear mechanism to bypass repeated content (skip link/landmarks/headings)
merged_issues.description: A bypass mechanism (such as a skip link, proper landmarks, or a clear heading structure) was not found or could not be verified automatically. Without it, keyboard and screen reader users may need to tab through repeated navigation on every page.
merged_issues.recommended_fix:
Provide at least one bypass method: add a visible-on-focus "Skip to main content" link targeting the main content container (e.g., Skip to main content and
...), and/or ensure appropriate landmark regions and headings are present.
